units.source_text: 夫人一边送小姐到大门口，一边将名片掖进和服腰带里，

en.t: As the lady escorted the young mistress to the front gate, she tucked the business card into the sash of her kimono,
and her hand touched the banknotes,

units.source_text: 这是刚才收到的狗店老板缴来的配种费用，

en.t: the stud fee she had just received from the owner of the dog shop,

units.source_text: 她竟忘记告诉小姐一声。

en.t: which she had completely forgotten to mention to the young mistress.

units.source_text: 此刻她不知该如何寒暄才好，

en.t: At that moment, she did not know what polite words she should say,
a flush rose across her face, and she said:
